title: Creation: log scrubber

creation.briefMd: scrub(input, output) writes unique trimmed names.

blocks.md:
## A tool you keep

`scrub(input, output)` reads UTF-8 from `input`, cleans names the same way as the transfer lesson, and writes that text to `output`. The next program can open the file. Printing names is not enough.

Print `ok` after writing `clean.txt` from `messy.txt`. Reuse a `clean` helper if you want — the hidden test calls `scrub` and then reads the file it wrote.

Night shift leaves `clean.txt` on the desk. Morning shift opens that file. They do not re-read the messy log.

choices.md: Write a file the next program can open

blocks.promptMd: `scrub` must write a file, not only print the cleaned names.
blocks.explainMd: Morning shift opens the output path. stdout is a notebook, not the kept list.

hintLadder.md: Read the input file as UTF-8. Clean it. Write the result to `output`.
Cleaning is the same rules: trim, drop blanks, unique, sort.

description: Keep a log scrubber you can run again.
